target.title: Control Chrome Keychain interaction per task
target.body:
Replaces #14 after the contributor withdrew the accidental agent-created PR. Preserves @Yuxin-Qiao's three authored commits, with maintainer follow-up for docs, fallback behavior, and proof.

## Summary

- add task-scoped `withUserInteractionDisallowed` control for Chromium cookie imports
- probe every Safe Storage alias without UI before selecting an interactive fallback
- cap the default path at one interactive Keychain lookup
- document opt-out usage and cover success, denial, cancellation, and failed authorization

## Local proof

- `swift test` — 57 tests passed
- `swift build -c release` — passed
- `swift package generate-documentation --target SweetCookieKit` — passed
- `swift build --package-path Examples/CookieCLI` — passed
- built `SweetCookieCLI --help` — passed
- `swiftlint lint --strict` — 0 violations
- changed-file `swiftformat --lint` — clean
- autoreview branch mode against `origin/main` — clean, no findings

## Real Chromium Keychain proof

Exact head `585259666c0702eb48dc63a34b54c8d0e145a40e` on an arm64 Mac with a real Google Chrome Default cookie store:

- example CLI and temporary public-API proof runner built successfully
- proof runner verified with a valid Developer ID signature before launch
- no-interaction: one real store, `accessDenied`, prompt handler count 0, 0.041 seconds, exit 0
- default: one real store, prompt handler count 1, `accessDenied`, 0.026 seconds, exit 0
- no timeout and no lingering proof process; no GUI prompt was clicked
- captured output contained response classes and counts only, never cookie or Keychain values

Do not merge automatically; maintainer handoff only.
